items.label: Oversized Soft Seating
items.value: This item is shipped in 5 boxes and may not be delivered at the same time. ComfCove oversized patio furniture is designed for true comfort, with each seat offering a generous 24.5-inch width and 27.5-inch depth—that’s wider and deeper than most standard outdoor patio sofa sets. Plus, the tall 30.8-inch high backrest supports you from shoulders to lower back, so you can truly lean back and unwind

items.label: Cloud-Like Comfort
items.value: Our aluminum patio furniture set features waterproof think cushions filled with high-density foam, delivering exceptional lumbar support and comfort. The ergonomic design perfectly aligns with your body's natural curves, letting you sink into blissful relaxation during lazy afternoons

items.label: All Weather Durable Material
items.value: This outdoor furniture set effortlessly handles all weather conditions. The rust-resistant aluminum frame is powder-coated to effectively resist corrosion and fading. The waterproof cushions are crafted from quick-drying, fade-resistant olefin fabric, requiring minimal maintenance and making them ideal for long-term outdoor use

items.label: Modular Design & Multi-scene Usage
items.value: Coffee mornings on the balcony, weekend gatherings by the pool, or evening chats in the garden. However you use your space, this outdoor patio conversation sets fits right in. Its adaptable design and modern style work with any outdoor aesthetic—from cozy balcony nooks to spacious deck layouts. However you love to enjoy the outdoors, this patio furniture set is ready to adapt

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: We provide clear instructions, labeled parts, and a complete toolkit, along with installation videos, so you can easily complete a hassle-free setup—typically within 30 minutes. New scratch-resistant footpads protect your patio or garden flooring, and cushions can be spot-cleaned with mild soapy water. Should you need assistance, our U.S.-based customer service team is available 24/7.
